## Appearance

Anne Shirley is a girl with a sweet face featuring a little pointed chin, a nice nose, and big, gray eyes. Her cheeks are sometimes faintly flushed with pink, and her bright hair, which was once dyed green, streams behind her when unbraided.

## Personality

Anne Shirley is a talkative, generous, and highly imaginative individual who possesses a particularly vivid imagination. Though she exhibits a optimistic outlook on life, she can also be careless and prone to doing reckless things. Her primary desires include staying at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), growing up to be good-looking, and eventually becoming a teacher like Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Additionally, she prefers to be called Cordelia and demonstrates a willingness to confess her mistakes to take responsibility for her actions, such as when she sought to secure her attendance at a picnic.

## History

Anne Shirley grew up as a fourteen-year-old orphan with no known family before being adopted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though sent by mistake instead of a boy, she was permitted to stay and settled into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she accidentally got her best friend [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) drunk on currant wine, accidentally dyed her red hair green with peddler's dye, fell off a roof during a dare, and accidentally seasoned a cake with liniment. After studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and passing her exams, she gave up a college scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and teach locally when Marilla's eyesight began to fail, reconciling with her rival [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when he gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so she could have it. As an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teacher, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold her neighbor's cow, accidentally applied rug dye to her nose before hosting important guests, and rejected an unromantic marriage proposal sent on behalf of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Moving on to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), she formed a close friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and moved into Patty's Place with her friends and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Along the way, [Diana](../character/diana.md) submitted one of Anne's stories to a baking powder contest without her permission, leading to a dismayed [Anne](../character/anne.md) winning first prize with commercial edits added to her work. Over the course of her college years, [Anne](../character/anne.md) refused a romantic marriage proposal from [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), spent time teaching at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), and successfully published a short sketch. At the end of her college life, [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejected a proposal from her wealthy suitor, [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), after realizing in the moment that she did not love him.

## Quotes

> "I’ll fold them nicely tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum. Half the time, though, I’d forget, I’d be in such a hurry to get into bed nice and quiet and imagine things."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002)

> "I’d do anything to oblige you. But you’ll have to tell me what to say for this once. After I get into bed I’ll imagine out a real nice prayer to say always. I believe that it will be quite interesting, now that I come to think of it."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P15](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0015)

> "But I’d be ever so much gratefuller if—if you’d made just one of them with puffed sleeves. Puffed sleeves are so fashionable now. It would give me such a thrill, Marilla, just to wear a dress with puffed sleeves."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

> "I’ll just eat one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them, can’t I? The other half will taste twice as sweet to me if I give some to her. It’s delightful to think I have something to give her."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) hit it off immediately upon meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and solemnly vowed to be best friends forever. They became close chums, sharing childhood outings, wandering [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) together, and maintaining a deep bond as they grew up. Their friendship remained steadfast through major life transitions, including Anne's eventual departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), +4 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) met early in Anne's time at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and instantly swore an oath to be lifelong best friends. Their friendship faced an early crisis when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana.md) currant wine, leading Diana's mother to temporarily forbid them from playing together, but they reconciled after [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's sister from croup. They remained inseparable schoolmates and chums, supporting each other through school events, story clubs, and life changes.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), +14 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as fierce academic rivals at school, with [Anne](../character/anne.md) harboring years of unilateral anger and intense contempt toward him after an early insult. Although [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) repeatedly attempted to apologize—even saving her from a sinking dory—[Anne](../character/anne.md) firmly refused his friendship for a long time. Over time, their rivalry softened into mutual respect as co-organizers of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and fellow college students, though tension re-emerged when [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejected his romantic proposal at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
